purpose: Exercise canonical Financial APEN memory with maturity-safe online updates, not prove market alpha.
metric: one-step MSE; OOS R2 vs named matched benchmark; no pooled cross-world MSE
preprocessing: Standardize features using mature training rows only; use exactly the same frozen ridge backbone for M04 and its no-memory contrast.
availability: Outcome for decision row t is released before prediction at t+1+2. Exclude immature training labels. Clock is logical steps, not calendar dates.
online_updates: Only already-predicted test outcomes that have matured are disclosed. Cold-start memory each fold. No in-sample residual warming. Boundary-purged labels are not later fed into online controls.
seed_interpretation: Five development seeds per world. Folds share training histories and are not independent replications. Worlds share seed identifiers; no pooled significance claim.
negative_control: The zero-residual-memory ablation must exactly match the ridge backbone. SIGNAL is contemporaneous latent signal; its causal lags do not expose that latent value.
source_policy: Fail closed if any of the eight original module Git blob hashes changes. Legacy protocols, code, results and holdout remain unchanged.
retuning: No outcome-driven hyperparameter search in this run.
